title: Conditions of Quotation for a Tier of the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs
content:
## Condition 1. Fit of the building

A tier of the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs is quoted only for a building whose equipment it fits. The site must carry at least the tier's minimum covered units and no more than its maximum, and every unit's filter size must be one the tier stocks; a building with filter sizes outside the stocked list is quoted with those units excluded. The minimum, the maximum and the stocked sizes are those of the tier being quoted, as the tier schedules state them.

## Condition 2. Filter schedule survey

A tier whose survey requirement is set is quoted only where a filter schedule survey for that building is recorded as completed in the office records, since the schedule fixes both the sizes and the count. The record that satisfies this condition is the survey intake lodged for the same building and carried to completed in the company's own air quality intake records; a survey the caller reports as done, but which the office records do not show as completed for that building, does not satisfy it.

## Condition 3. Maintenance agreement at the building

A tier that requires maintenance is quoted only where the building holds a maintenance agreement in active or pending renewal status. The agreement is read from the company's maintenance agreement records for the same building; an agreement in any other status, or an agreement at another of the owner's buildings, does not satisfy the condition.

## Condition 4. Setup fee

The setup fee is charged when the program starts and is not refunded if the owner later cancels. The fee is the setup fee of the tier the program is written at.

## Combinations of the conditions

| Unit count inside the tier's range and every unit's size stocked | Survey completed in the office records, where the tier requires one | Maintenance agreement active or pending renewal at the building, where the tier requires one | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | The tier is quoted |
| Yes, save that some units take a size the tier does not stock | Yes | Yes | The tier is quoted with those units excluded |
| Unit count outside the range | Yes | Yes | The tier is not quoted for the building |
| Yes | No | Yes | The tier is not quoted |
| Yes | Yes | No | The tier is not quoted |

A tier that requires no survey is quoted without one, and a tier that requires no maintenance agreement is quoted without one; the corresponding column is then not read.

## Points of judgement

- A maintenance agreement in any status other than active or pending renewal does not satisfy Condition 3, whatever the caller states about it.
- The setup fee is charged once, when the program starts; a cancellation at any later date does not return it.
